ORDINANCE XLII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XLII OF 1984
PAKISTAN COUNCIL OF SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Council of Scientific and
Industrial Research Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th September, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information : -
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) The Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Addition of new section 3-A, Act XXX of 1973

ORDINANCE XLII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XLII OF 1984
PAKISTAN COUNCIL OF SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Council of Scientific and
Industrial Research Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th September, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information : -
2. Addition of new section 3-A, Act XXX of 1973.--In the Pakistan
Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973 (XXX of 1973), in
Chapter I, after section 3, the following new section shall be added, namely :-
"3-A. Ordinance XXIII of
1969 not to apply to Council.-Nothing contained in the Industrial Relations
Ordinance, 1969 (XXIII of 1969), shall apply to or in relation to the Council
or any of the officers, advisers and employees appointed by it." -
